entities.summary: Pavel Kotsur (b. 1974-01-03, Astana) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Astana and Kazakhstan. Known in the fields of kazakhstan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
